newsitem.title: USA: Planned topless club bombed in Arkansas.
newsitem.headline: Planned topless club bombed in Arkansas.

text.p: - Authorities are investigating the Thursday morning bombing of a building intended to house the first topless nightclub in Fort Smith, Ark.
Minimal damage was reported to the empty structure. A second, unexploded pipe bomb was found in the building's foyer, according to Bill Sadler, a spokesman for the Arkansas State Police.
Fort Smith, a city of about 70,000, is located on the Arkansas border with Oklahoma.

Members of a nearby conservative religious congregation near the bomb site have repeatedly protested plans to open the adult nightclub, to be named Regina's Topless Bar. The owners of the club have said they will sue to overturn the city council's refusal to grant an operating permit.
Sadler said detectives would consider all possibilities in searching for suspects, including any possible connection to the local protest.

He said there was no apparent connection between the nightclub bombing and the discovery of a third explosive device later Thursday morning on the city's outskirts. Six sticks of dynamite attached to two plastic jugs of flammable liquid were found along a highway.
